snippet.title: Bionicle: Quest for Mata Nui - Update #6 - Revised Mask Systems (Fan Made Open-World RPG Game)
snippet.description:
Bionicle: Quest for Mata Nui is a free fan made open-world RPG game that is set in the universe of Lego Bionicle. The project has been in development for the last six years.

In this update we take a closer look at our new revised mask systems.

Set during the first year of Bionicle, it follows the story of the Toa on their quest to collect the 6 great masks of power to rid the island of Mata Nui of the evil influence called Makuta.

Join our discord server for more info and regular updates!
https://discord.gg/jTfxtbD

-
